description: Four polyphonic quantizers sharing one keyboard of note buttons, named scales and thirty-two stored note sets

params.text: Turns that note on or off in the working scale that all four channels use
Attenuates that channel's incoming signal before it is quantized, 0% to 100%
Shifts that channel's quantized note up or down by whole octaves, three either way
Applies the pending scale or program, and applies note-button edits made to a pending scale
Selects a named scale: the centre is chromatic, clockwise gives the major scales and anticlockwise the minor ones
Puts the scale the SCALE knob shows into the working scale
Applies a scale or program change the moment it is made, instead of waiting for the SET button
Selects one of the thirty-two stored note sets, 0 to 31
Double-click to store the notes now shown into the selected program
Loads the selected program into the working scale

inputs.text: Moves the scale selection, ±10V added to the SCALE knob
Selects the program by voltage, or steps to the next stored one on each trigger with Prog Input type set to Trig
A trigger here samples that channel's input and holds its quantized note until the next trigger
The signal that channel quantizes; with nothing patched it takes the signal from the channel above
A voltage added to that channel's signal before it is quantized

notes: with no notes turned on there is no quantization and nothing at the outputs, so at least one note button has to be lit.
the four channels share one scale; only the attenuation, octave, trigger and offset are separate.
a program is only saved by double-clicking STOR; editing the note buttons and moving on loses the changes.
menu: Prog Input type: CV, Trig — chooses whether the PROG jack reads a voltage or steps to the next stored program on each trigger
Scan Last Prog — reads every program again and reports the highest one that holds anything
SUM chans to poly out #1: — sums the first channels into output 1 as a polyphonic cable, one channel per row, leaving the other outputs working as usual
Load PROG preset — reads all thirty-two programs from a file
Save PROG preset — writes all thirty-two programs to a file that another sickoQuant can read
Erase ALL progs — clears every stored program, behind an 'Are you Sure?' submenu whose only item is ERASE!
Tips — a submenu that only prints a reminder to store programs with a double-click on STOR
